levels.surface: محمد بن يحيى بن سعيد القطان

notes: «فسألته عنه فقال عن أبيه» : the question is about an unnamed narrator («عنه»), and the answer is a chain for him that the text does not write out; the reading covers only the names here (rule 11)
«لم تر أهل الخير في شىء أكذب منهم» is the words of Qattan; «قال مسلم يقول» is the compiler's remark, not written
